extra.message: Insecure Deserialization via pickle in case_bundle_thaw_181 — Remote code execution on the server, leading to full compromise of the application and data. [verified: The view `case_bundle_thaw_181` passes attacker-controlled data from `request.body` or `request.GET.get('blob')` directly into `pickle.loads()` without any sanitization, allowing arbitrary code execution if the gate check passes.]

Remote Code Execution via eval in case_formula_cast_264 — Remote code execution on the server, leading to full compromise of the application and data. [verified: The case_formula_cast_264 view takes the 'expr' GET parameter and passes it to eval() on line 87 with restricted builtins. Known sandbox escape techniques (e.g., using object introspection) allow arbitrary code execution. The _wrk_gate check only enforces authentication/authorization, not input validation.]
